purpose: A computed SeNd first-class capture keeps its Generator alive after source receiver/name retirement. A pack producer clears the sole capture variable; the actual capture survives body execution, then retires before its Generator finally and before caller return.
source:
<?php
function stream112P() {
    global $weakGenerator, $weakCapture;
    try {
        echo 'INIT|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof Closure, '|';
        $value = yield 'head'; echo 'VALUE|', $value, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof Closure, '|'; yield 'tail';
    } finally { echo 'FIN|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCapture->get() instanceof Closure, '|'; }
}
function pack112P() { global $capture; echo 'PACK|', $capture instanceof Closure, '|'; $capture=null; return ['value'=>41]; }
$generator=stream112P(); $weakGenerator=WeakReference::create($generator); $method='SeNd';
$capture=$generator->{$method}(...); $weakCapture=WeakReference::create($capture); $generator=null; $method='throw';
echo 'CAPTURE|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|';
$result=$capture(...pack112P());
echo 'RETURN|', $result === 'tail', '|', $capture===null, '|', $weakGenerator->get()===null, '|', $weakCapture->get()===null, '|';

purpose: An ignored owning CURRENT return clears before releasing the active capture. An empty-pack producer clears its last variable; the cached Token destructor sees the Generator still live but the retired capture already dead.
source:
<?php
class Token112D {
    function __destruct() { global $weakGenerator, $weakCapture; echo 'TOKEN|', $weakGenerator->get() instanceof Generator, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|'; }
}
function stream112D() { try { echo 'INIT|'; yield new Token112D(); } finally { echo 'FIN|'; } }
function pack112D() { global $capture; echo 'PACK|'; $capture = null; return []; }
$generator = stream112D(); $weakGenerator = WeakReference::create($generator);
$capture = $generator->current(...); $weakCapture = WeakReference::create($capture); $generator = null;
echo 'CALL|'; $capture(...pack112D());
echo 'AFTER|', $weakGenerator->get() === null, '|', $weakCapture->get() === null, '|';
